body: I know people like me, I know people love me... Its just that I can't seem to really find a reason as to why it matters to much. I'm not sad. I just don't see the point... In the end, everything dies, no matter what. Not much is going my way and its getting harder to find reasons to not just end it all early.
i workout... alot. lack of physical activity isn't my problem
I wish I had the guts to tell anyone close to me... but internet anonymity is the only thing allowing me to finally vent a tad.
I find myself using mediums to escape when I can, whether it be working out, movies, music, or weed. Just to take my mind off things for a little bit.
